sampling: One independently selected changed range per active pair, authored and visually inspected before comparison. Partial reference: all unannotated predictions require separate adjudication.
comparison_convention: Compare the selected policy sentence, introductory paragraph, abstract, or named form field across publication revisions. Literal annotation preserves raw whitespace, glyph sharing and footnote digits. This reference does not assert a unique author edit history.
visible_text_caveat: Old source is a scanned page with OCR-like stored text. Literal source references follow that stored text, whose errors differ from the visible document. Visible paragraphs also change, but no glyph-to-image transcription proof is claimed.
